summary: Summit lookout 1909-1938, Air Force radar site 1957-62, 41-ft R-6 tower 1964-1989. Its top 30 ft is now a viewing platform at Big Meadow Lake.

facts.design: R-6 flat-roof cab on a 41-ft treated timber tower (1964)
facts.status_note: Top 30 ft of the 41-ft 1964 tower went to Big Meadow Lake in 1989; the rest was torn down. No source read describes the summit today.

staffing.status: lookout staffed in 1930 and 1967 per sources; no end date found

access.note: Viewing platform at Big Meadow Lake campground. An undated WillhiteWeb visit found access closed for vandalism. Summit access is not described in any source read.

visit.trail_note: Paved trail to the viewing platform; vehicles reach the campground from Colville or Ione

events.note: Log cabin added to the camp at the summit
Newspaper account (quoted by Rex's page) describes the lookout on North Baldy phoning the forest supervisor
Air Force acquires 56.5 acres from the Forest Service and Northern Pacific Railway for a radar site with a steel radar tower
Site declared excess in 1961; property returned to the Forest Service in 1962
41-ft treated timber tower with R-6 flat-roof cab
Known lookout personnel listed as Susan Wright
Tower torn down; top 30 ft moved to Big Meadow Lake as a wildlife viewing tower. Rex's page says the whole tower moved.

corrections.current: None relocated (The lookout was moved to Big Meadow Lake.)
corrections.proposed: 1989: tower torn down; top 30 ft of the 41-ft 1964 tower moved to Big Meadow Lake
corrections.why: Firetower.org and WillhiteWeb both say only the top 30 feet of the 41-foot tower went to Big Meadow Lake. The lookout as a whole did not move.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firetower.org gives 1928; firelookout.com gives 1925. The story uses 1928 and says the other source differs.

Rex's page says the lookout's tower moved to Big Meadow Lake; firetower.org and WillhiteWeb say the top 30 feet of the 41-foot tower moved and the rest was torn down. The story follows the two more specific accounts and notes Rex's version.

notes_for_editor: The brief's design R-6 and height_m 12.5 describe the 1964 41-ft tower and are kept. The 1938 40-ft pole L-4 was an earlier tower; both are in events. Open conflicts: cupola cabin 1928 vs 1925, and whether the whole tower or only its top 30 ft went to Big Meadow Lake (Rex's page vs firetower.org and WillhiteWeb). Big Meadow access is from an undated visit report and needs a current check before anyone is advised to visit. Not verified: summit condition today and summit access. No photos added; the FFLOS record already holds three North Baldy photos.
